body: **Plot season 1:** the civilians of 3050 (year) have uncontrollably been looking for the invention of the time machine. Until scientist Slate Yakrane (weird names in the future) had showed the world his time machine. Everyone thought it was an amazing discovery. Not knowing it would lead to chaos.

Edward Riktide had also made a time machine 30 years earlier. Since he was the 1st, he was the first to see the destruction. He had hoped that no one would also make their own and be careless. On 3050 june 6th, yukrane and the president started allowing…

sections.title: On Conformity
body: people never change unless they willingly want to change, unless they see and reflect on what theyve done. but the thing is people dont care cuz they just comfortable, and they comfortable and comfortable and its all okay and woohooo i fit in so well in this little comfort bubble whats there not to love why would and why should i even bother to consider if im doing anything wrong (until something goes wrong then they see it all for themselves). (also it ultimately doesn't matter, i actually envy ppls bliss, ppl should b allowed to feel good.) but wow.

honestly, im so tired of seeing the same people. the same copy n pastes. the same people who just imitate and dont care nor value nor give credit nor are grateful for the things that have helped put them there. i know so many ppl that are hurt and shrugged away by the same conforming and stale and boring and lame and blind individuals. its so sad that in this day and age so many people are still so simple and treat things like a high school cafeteria.

like mannnnnn. humble ur damn self. give some love to others. help others. involve others. b mindful of others. the same way u so desperately want to involve urself because its safe to ur ego. because that way no one questions you or looks at you funny for "falling out of line."

if ur friends question you for doing something thats right instead of conforming, then THEY AINT YOUR DAMN FRIENDS. THEYRE NO GOOD. THEY ONLY CARE ABOUT THEMSELVES AND MAKING THEMSELVES LOOK GOOD BECAUSE IT KEEPS THEIR EGO SAFE AND IT SCARES THEM TO THINK THAT THE REST OF THEIR CONFORMING FRIEND GROUP LOOKS AT THEM FUNNY.
people write books on this, on how conformity is a huge mess and so many people are so deep into it that theres almost no saving them.

the matter of the fact is that if you wouldnt want someone doing it to you then you don't do it to others!!!!!!!!!! you are what keeps war alive in humanity. we are all brothers and sisters, we all share the same experience. humble urself and show love.

bruh im literally half asleep i feel fried. but i was just thinking about how i know so many people that have been wronged by others due to the same similar set of circumstances and it IRRITATES me. it really does.
so yeah.
dont do things to conform and to feel safe and unquestioned. **DO THINGS BASED ON YOUR OWN SET OF MORALS AND WHAT YOU THINK IS RIGHT.**
(even tho sometimes ppls morals ain't enough, some ppl r just messed up.)
everything i said in that post is nonsense, its just me ranting, i only care if u read this line.
also not an attack on anyone HERE, but if u feel attacked then hmmmmmm.
i love u guys btw. maybe i sound mad critical or harsh but im deadass so tired i feel fried in the head, but this stuff makes me so passionate cuz yea.

sections.title: On Being Taught God
body: new age spiritualists frustrate me. or at least the people that adopt it as yet another belief system, the same way christians are born into christianity and are spoon fed doctrine. not garbage — but u cant teach god to people, its not that simple. so when they eat it they store it in their wonderland, but in reality its completely hollow, as its not like they actually understand what theyre being told.

its the same w the new age "spiritualists," except they are a little more on the right track as they may possibly have more evidence for metaphysical things. but it wears on me when i realize the amount of ppl that dont question anything and adopt it. except adopting new age "spirituality" is far worse than like preaching the christian word, cuz new age spiritual ppl that have no clue what they spit out or learn are a million times more delusional and can twist the word of god far more when trying to preach to others.

i remember another betrayal was when i realized none of them actually knew what they were talking about either. in the most ignorant way it made me sick, just like my view on christians when i was an atheist.
i wonder how or if god can actually be taught. like an actual set of "pointers" that explains it can only be found within you, and at the degree that you want to understand it or embody it.
there are some thoughts i have that i just wanna yell out but im not sure if theyre true or not, plus other fears around them, so i stay silent.
i am upset, excuse me.
